help.title: **Welcome to WeChat message forwarding bot**
help.description:
[This project](https://github.com/finalpi/wechat2tg) is a project for sending and receiving WeChat messages in Telegram based on WeChat protocol, supporting multiple protocols including ipad, mac, car, windows, pad\.
**This project is only for technical research and learning, not for illegal purposes\.**
help.instructions:
1\. Use the /start or /login command to start the WeChat client instance, and use the /login command to scan the code to log in\.
2\. Use the /user or /room command to search for contacts or group chats \(you can add names or remarks, for example, "/user Zhang" can search for users whose names or remarks contain "Zhang"\)\.
3\. /settings to open settings\.
4\. For more features, please check the GitHub repository README\.
